_policy: A gate whose red nobody has seen is unproven, not passing. Automated proofs are derived from the test-<name> naming convention; this file records the ones that convention cannot see. Enforced by scripts/check-gate-proofs.py; the unproven COUNT is held by the ratchet metric `gates_without_proof`.

check-release-archive.evidence: on the unmodified tree both configurations archive (exit 0). With `return .developerIDMutant` inside DistributionChannel.swift's `#elseif DEVELOPER_ID_BETA` branch — code Debug never compiles, so Mac Build cannot see it — the developer-id archive exits 1 naming DistributionChannel.swift:37, and the appstore archive stays green, which is why both are compiled
check-release-archive.how: manual, local, unsigned exactly as the push-triggered runner does it: desktop/scripts/check-release-archive.sh developer-id and appstore against the mutated tree, then the file restored

check-release-freeze.evidence: exit 1 with a live lock, naming the version and pid and the override; exit 0 for the release's own commit (BN_RELEASE_RUN), for BN_RELEASE_FREEZE_OK=1, for a dead driver's pid, and with no .release dir; exit 1 from a worktree against the main checkout's lock
check-release-freeze.how: scripts/test-release-sh.sh, block 'check-release-freeze': a throwaway git repo with .release/9.9.0/.lock/pid set to a live pid, then a dead one, plus a linked worktree

check-bundle-integrity.evidence: exit 1, '1 of 1 Mach-O files have a hole', names the file and offset; the unmodified copy exits 0. Real bundle never touched. LIMIT FOUND: 42 of the bundle's Mach-Os have a __text smaller than one page, so at --min-run 4096 they are unscannable by construction — the first probe (a 1,972-byte __text) stayed green for that reason, not because the checker was broken.
check-bundle-integrity.how: manual: copied a bundle .so to a temp dir, zeroed 4096 bytes inside __TEXT,__text using the checker's own section parser, ran at the default threshold

check-bundle-manifest.evidence: exit 1, '1 uncovered runtime-data file(s) found'; exit 0 after removal; tree clean
check-bundle-manifest.how: manual: dropped bristlenose/zz_gate_proof/probe.yaml, an uncovered runtime-data dir, then removed it

check-gate-policy.evidence: exit codes checked under bash, not zsh; clean 0, expired 1, restored 0
check-gate-policy.how: manual: all four paths — undeclared, expired, stale, bad disposition

check-gate-proofs.evidence: exit 1 naming check-ratchet as stale; exit 0 after restore
check-gate-proofs.how: manual: back-dated a declared proof and ran --stale 180

check-mcp-helper.evidence: control exit 0 ('1 copy ok', app.bristlenose.mcp.dev, macOS 15.0+). Ad-hoc re-signed copy, no entitlements: exit 1, naming not sandboxed, no network.client, application-groups null, TeamIdentifier not set, identifier/signer mismatch. Control plus that copy together: exit 1, adds 'code differs … (CDHash … vs …)'. A same-signer re-sign without the group did NOT land (no signing identity reachable from the shell), so the group-only case is unobserved here; it is the same entitlement read as the ad-hoc row.
check-mcp-helper.how: manual: copies of a Debug build's Contents/Helpers/bristlenose-mcp in a temp dir; the shipped app untouched

check-mockup-register.evidence: exit 1 in both directions, exit 0 at baseline and after restore. Added by the concurrent session in b087ce94 without a proof; the ratchet caught it at 14 > 13 during close-out, and this is the fix that weakens nothing.
check-mockup-register.how: manual, both directions: a mockup on disk with no STATUS.md row; a STATUS.md row naming a file not on disk; register restored byte-identical

check-ratchet.evidence: SUPERSEDED 4 Sep 2026 by scripts/test-check-ratchet.py, which reclassifies this gate as automated — check-gate-proofs.py no longer reads this entry. Kept because the automated proof drives stub metrics, and this one drove the real tree: pytest_slow_marked: 8 > ceiling 7; clean restore verified
check-ratchet.how: manual: added a real @pytest.mark.slow, saw it named and refused

check-sidecar-freshness.evidence: exit 1 STALE (bundle 3efb0d7d vs source b82fb204); exit 0 '✓ matches source' with the faked stamp; exit 1 again after restore. Bypass env unset throughout.
check-sidecar-freshness.how: manual: the real stamp (bundle predates today's edits) vs a stamp rewritten to the current sidecar_source_hash, then restored byte-identical

gen-test-inventory.how: CI: un-regenerated real drift went red, ruff green above it

check-python-band.why: Not a gate. A measurement run by hand at the quarterly tooling review to answer 'are we inside the CPython band?' — it reports a number, it does not pass or fail, so there is no red to observe.

gen-test-inventory.note: Not named check-*, but --check is a hard CI gate.

test-swift.note: Not named check-*, but it is the Swift suite's only entry point, called from mac-build.yml, build-all.sh 1c, build-dmg.sh 1b and /end-session.
